short: The share of customers who keep buying from you.
seoTitle: Retention Rate — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Retention rate is the percentage of existing customers who continue to buy over a period. It is the complement of churn and the foundation of lifetime value.
definition: Retention rate is the percentage of existing customers who continue to buy over a period. It is the complement of churn and the foundation of lifetime value.
bodyHtml:
Why Retention Rate matters

Retention is the cheapest growth there is. Keeping an existing customer costs a fraction of acquiring a new one, and retained customers usually spend more per visit.

Retention Rate formula

Retention rate % = Customers retained at period end ÷ Customers at start × 100

Exclude new customers acquired during the period.

How Retention Rate works in practice

Improve it with the ordinary things: consistency, service recovery when something goes wrong, and a reason to come back. Measure it by cohort so a good month is not confused with a durable improvement.

faq.question: What improves retention fastest?
faq.answer: Consistency and how failures are handled. A well-handled complaint often produces a more loyal customer than a flawless visit.

faq.question: Is retention or acquisition more important?
faq.answer: Retention, almost always. It costs less and compounds, but it produces slower headline growth.
